content.text:
The standard is:
`lake env lean -j1 -o .lake/build/lib/lean/tmp/sheaf/xif/paper/S1832ActualCoverPullbacksActual.olean tmp/sheaf/xif/paper/S1832ActualCoverPullbacksActual.lean`

Let me run that, capture exit code, then compute SHA256 of the .lean (and maybe the olean), and verify the olean exists.

Also, to be a good citizen: prior reports suggest writing a report in coord/reports? The task says just write the Lean file and report SHA/EXIT/olean. The parent will handle state. But AGENTS.md says "本包结束更新节点、STATE 与 queue" — as a subagent, the parent coordinates; I shouldn't update shared state files (risk of conflicting with parent). I'll report to the parent with details, and let it update. Hmm, but the workspace instructions say to update node/STATE/queue at the end of the package. Since I'm a delegated subagent and the parent owns coordination, I'll not edit shared state, but I'll provide the exact information the parent needs. Actually — to be safe and compliant, maybe I should append a brief note to AUDIT_LEDGER? The instructions say research facts and failed routes should be appended to AUDIT_LEDGER.md. But concurrent writes by the parent may conflict. I'll not modify shared docs; I'll include the finding in my message to the parent so it can record. That's the safer choice for a subagent; and the parent explicitly asked only for the Lean file + report.

Let me now run the olean build. Then double check the olean's existence and SHA.

content.name: run_code
content.arguments:
{"code": "
const res = await tools.pwsh({description:"Build olean for S1832", command:`cd D:\\lean
$ol = ".lake/build/lib/lean/tmp/sheaf/xif/paper/S1832ActualCoverPullbacksActual.olean"
lake env lean -j1 -o $ol tmp/sheaf/xif/paper/S1832ActualCoverPullbacksActual.lean *> tmp/sheaf/xif/paper/logs/S1832_olean1.log
$c = $LASTEXITCODE
Write-Output ('EXITCODE=' + $c)
Select-String -Path tmp/sheaf/xif/paper/logs/S1832_olean1.log -Pattern 'error|sorry|warning' | Out-String -Width 250
Get-ChildItem $ol | Select-Object FullName,Length,LastWriteTime | Out-String -Width 250
Write-Output "=== SHA256 ==="
Get-FileHash tmp/sheaf/xif/paper/S1832ActualCoverPullbacksActual.lean -Algorithm SHA256 | Select-Object Hash,Path | Out-String -Width 250
Get-FileHash $ol -Algorithm SHA256 | Select-Object Hash | Out-String -Width 250`, timeoutMs: 900000});
console.log(res.kind==="foreground"? (res.stdout.text+"\n"+res.stderr.text) : JSON.stringify(res));
", "description": "Produce olean and compute hashes"}
